verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents a REST API with an OpenAPI spec covering people and companies, and the API can create and change real records, so an agent could create a lead and write company data. Enrichment is offered in-product, but nothing shows it can be triggered via the API, owner assignment is not documented, and no MCP server appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: API-triggered enrichment, documented owner-assignment endpoint or field, an official MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner
